summary: HomesToLife Ltd, a Singapore-based furniture retailer listed in the US, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice of extraordinary general meeting and proxy statement for a meeting on October 27, 2026. Shareholders will vote on a special resolution adopting a Third Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association to meet SGX-ST listing requirements and authorize board-declared dividends, including from share premium, plus an ordinary resolution granting a general mandate for interested person transactions effective upon SGX-ST listing. No transaction terms, advisors, or deal mechanics are disclosed; the items are routine charter and governance approvals tied to a secondary listing, with no risk-arb angle.
